summary: Iteration 250 — Validated SupportActionsAuditMiddleware + GET /api/super-admin/support-actions + new 'Acciones de soporte' SA tab. All 9 backend pytest cases pass and the frontend Playwright run validated the tab, refresh button, table contents (3 rows, POST/200 with correct emerald badges) and column layout. One PRE-EXISTING regression unrelated to this iteration: test_login_audit.py::test_login_wrong_password_returns_401_and_logs — login_attempts list does not contain the invalid-credentials entry (likely IP-based rate limiting or list filter); test_2fa_totp.py and test_partner_login_flow.py all pass.

minor.issue: Pre-existing: wrong-password attempt is not surfaced in /api/login-attempts list during the test run (rate-limit or IP filter?) — UNRELATED to iter250 middleware. test_login_audit.py::TestLoginAttempts::test_login_wrong_password_returns_401_and_logs fails.

action_items: Investigate (separately) why /api/login-attempts no longer surfaces wrong-password rows — affects test_login_audit.py only; not introduced by iter250.
critical_code_review_comments: support_actions_audit.py is clean: middleware never raises (try/except around insert), skips read-only and SA endpoints, decodes Bearer JWT with the same JWT_SECRET as the main app, and excludes _id when listing — good.

Minor: SupportActionsAuditMiddleware enriches the row with company_id via an extra db.users.find_one on every logged mutation. Consider embedding company_id directly in the impersonation JWT (issued in /super-admin/companies/{cid}/impersonate) to avoid the lookup hop per audited call.
Minor: user_agent is truncated to 300 chars but ip is not capped. Add a defensive cap (e.g., 64 chars) to avoid huge X-Forwarded-For chains being persisted.

list_support_actions sorts by created_at (string ISO) which works because all timestamps are now() UTC isoformat with the same length, but consider storing a datetime field for index-friendly sorting at scale.
SuperAdminPage.jsx already noted in iter249 as 1256 lines — still applies. Adding the new tab + state grew it further; consider splitting into <CompaniesTab/>, <SupportActionsTab/>, etc.

success_rate.backend: 100% on iter250 suite (9/9). Regression suite: 30/31 = 96.8% (1 pre-existing failure in test_login_audit unrelated to iter250).
success_rate.frontend: 100% — tab visible, panel renders, Cargar fetches, table shows expected rows and badge colors.

seed_data_creation: Several support_actions rows were inserted as a side-effect of the impersonated POST /api/onboarding/dismiss in tests. They are intentional audit rows; no cleanup performed (audit logs are append-only by design).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://company-config-debug.preview.emergentagent.com pytest backend/tests/test_iter250_support_actions_audit.py -v — runs in ~7s. Frontend: SA login at /admin uses a 2-input form (username/password) then redirects to the dashboard; new tab data-testid='tab-support-actions' is the 7th tab (between Facturas pendientes and Soporte). All 6 columns present. Method badge classes confirmed: emerald for POST, etc.
rca of the issue: N/A — the iteration is feature-complete. The single failing regression test (test_login_audit wrong-password) was already not detected as part of this iteration's scope and produces 401s but the listing endpoint returns only success=True rows in this run; the middleware does not touch login endpoints (SKIP_PATH_PREFIXES includes /api/auth/login).
